subjects: dsh: read a session's head from a prefix, and remember cards between scans (#80)

An agent turn's tool record has a switch on each turn: an imported turn's tool calls and results arrive switched off, so a question below reads one line naming the files the turn touched, and the side panel's handoff line shows the record's steps and size with a switch that passes it on (undoable; answers already written below are marked as upstream changed); the context chain row says when a turn's record reaches the question; the thinking a turn spent is counted on import (Claude Code: billed output beyond the visible part, since its log keeps only a summary; Codex: its running reasoning total; Pi: its reasoning count; DeepSeek Harness: the reasoning text) and shows on the card as a count that is not passed on; the card's bar draws what passes on as solid and what stays as hatched; turns already on a canvas keep their record as it was; npm run test:turn-context checks the importers' counts, the switch and what a question below reads

A Harness Agent question that starts a fresh session files it under the harness workspace whose folder it runs in (#85): the harness puts a session in a workspace only when it is created with the workspace's id, so a session created with the workspace's folder alone landed in Ungrouped, and so did any fork of it; the plugin now matches the folder (through realpath, as the harness stores workspace paths) against the registered workspaces and creates by the id when one matches, by the folder otherwise, and a host without the workspace registry gets the folder as before; with no folder chosen, mirrored or shown in the chat, the question runs in the canvas's own folder, the one the folder chip names, instead of the harness's profile directory; npm run test:harness-workspace checks the create request on a stand-in host
0.5.27: each agent turn's tool record has its own switch and newly imported turns start with it off; Harness sessions started from the canvas are filed under their workspace

Condensing runs on an API model, never an agent (#85): the condense window listed every model and its default followed the picker, so with the picker on the Harness Agent each run's distillate was a whole agent turn, a session with tools started in the harness's profile directory and filed under Ungrouped; the window now lists the API models only, its automatic entry names the one the background order picks (the picked model when it is an API model, else the last API model picked, the list's default, then the rest) and the run uses it, and with no API model at all the run stops with a line saying so

Merge #82: the session map reads a session's head from a prefix of its log and remembers cards between scans (fixes #80): a head costs a byte window of the zstd log instead of the whole decoded log, the plugin answers GET /disksessions/<id>/head and walks the session tree at most every two seconds, the title reader stops at the frame that completes the title, the desktop shell's head read uses the same decoder (runtime/zstd-frames.cjs, shared by both), the canvas drops a disk session's expired text on every write to its cache, and cards are remembered by root, file, size and modification time
